models_evaluated: cloud-based deep learning AI for vision-threatening disease referral (unnamed)

links.outcome: AI referral accuracy and ungradable rate in real-world community non-mydriatic screenings versus gold standard
links.effect: 38.9% of eyes ungradable by AI versus 2.6% by humans; sensitivity 63.2%, specificity 94.5%, PPV 32.0%, NPV 98.4%; all 4 eyes with multiple diseases referred.
links.quote: Deep learning artificial intelligence had 63.2% sensitivity, 94.5% specificity, 32.0% positive predictive value, and 98.4% negative predictive value in vision-threatening disease referrals.

screen.reason: Prospective real-world deployment evaluating the diagnostic performance and processing time of a cloud-based deep learning system for retinal screening in an underserved community, but does not compare or test specific deployment practices/safeguards.
